statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model_name=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); project_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.project_dir'); current_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); output_style=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.output_style.name'); usage=$(echo "$input" | jq '.context_window.current_usage'); rel_path=$(python3 -c "import os; print(os.path.relpath('$current_dir', '$project_dir'))" 2>/dev/null || echo "$(basename "$current_dir")"); if [ "$rel_path" = "." ]; then rel_path="$(basename "$project_dir")"; fi; context_info=""; if [ "$usage" != "null" ]; then current=$(echo "$usage" | jq '.input_tokens + .cache_creation_input_tokens + .cache_read_input_tokens'); size=$(echo "$input" | jq '.context_window.context_window_size'); pct=$((current * 100 / size)); context_info=$(printf " \033[38;5;244m·\033[0m \033[38;5;cyan m%d%%\033[0m" "$pct"); fi; printf "\033[2m%s\033[0m \033[38;5;39m%s\033[0m%s \033[38;5;244m·\033[0m \033[38;5;214m%s\033[0m" "$model_name" "$rel_path" "$context_info" "$output_style"
